claim_one_line: THE HIGGS'S END DATA IS THE UNIT (P-245; exact, no data): FK10's tagged unit as W46 defines it (n uniform units; B1641's index -chi_{3/2+12n}(rho_T), rho_T = rho_R by B1634) makes the weight-3/2 sections of rho_T a three-dimensional space -- W46's three -- spanned by DR, E4^2(E4 DR + E6 R/12)/Delta and E4 E6 a0/Delta; DR lies in it and is its only member holomorphic off v+ (the coupling triplet R's own end condition); only DR gives a second-to-third hierarchy at the cusp (m2/m3 ~ |q|^(1/2); exponent 0 for the other members and generic ones). So the hierarchy's end data are FK10's unit, not a second postulate, but the unit does not select DR: the hierarchy arcs hold given Lambda, the unit and H-cov in R's own module. 0 of 19.
